_readme: Items whose price the filter cannot see. Everything listed here is tiered 'varies'
instead of on its price, whatever that price says.
The reason is always the same: an item filter matches a base type and nothing else,
and for these the base type does not carry the value. A Scrying Orb on the floor is
worth 2c or 992c depending on which map it is attuned to, and the block cannot tell.
Tiering it at the top claims every one is worth a divine; tiering it at the bottom
claims none is worth stopping for. Both are wrong, so neither is said.
Names are matched after the variant bracket is stripped, so 'Scrying Orb' covers
'Scrying Orb (Basilica)' and every map added later without an edit here.
Manually maintained. Add a name when you find a base type hiding a spread; nothing
in the market feeds can work this out on its own.
A name that matches nothing in the league is ignored rather than an error.
